skills.name: Differentiate between scalar and vector quantities
skills.tier_1_metric: Define scalar and vector quantities; identify common examples (e.g., distance/displacement, speed/velocity).
skills.tier_2_metric: Classify given physical quantities in a problem as scalar or vector; justify the classification based on definition.

skills.name: Define and distinguish between distance and displacement
skills.tier_1_metric: Define distance and displacement; state their SI units.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate distance and displacement for an object following a specified path; compare their values for non-linear motion.

skills.name: Define and distinguish between speed and velocity
skills.tier_1_metric: Define average speed and average velocity; state their SI units.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate average speed and average velocity for an object undergoing motion; explain the difference in their calculation for a round trip.

skills.name: Define and calculate acceleration
skills.tier_1_metric: Define acceleration; state its SI units and vector nature.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate average acceleration from initial and final velocities and time; interpret the sign of acceleration in one-dimensional motion.

skills.name: Interpret position-time (x-t) graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify position, displacement, and time from an x-t graph; describe motion (e.g., rest, constant velocity, acceleration).
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate instantaneous velocity from the gradient of an x-t graph; compare velocities of multiple objects from their x-t graphs.

skills.name: Interpret velocity-time (v-t) graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify velocity, time, and acceleration from a v-t graph; describe motion (e.g., constant velocity, constant acceleration).
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate displacement from the area under a v-t graph; determine instantaneous acceleration from the gradient of a v-t graph.

skills.name: Interpret acceleration-time (a-t) graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify acceleration and time from an a-t graph.
skills.tier_2_metric: Infer changes in velocity from the area under an a-t graph; relate an a-t graph to its corresponding v-t graph.

skills.name: Sketch motion graphs from given scenarios or other graphs
skills.tier_1_metric: Sketch a basic x-t, v-t, or a-t graph for simple constant velocity or constant acceleration scenarios.
skills.tier_2_metric: Construct a v-t graph from a given x-t graph; sketch an a-t graph corresponding to a v-t graph.

skills.name: Recall and state the SUVAT equations
skills.tier_1_metric: List the five SUVAT equations; identify each variable (s, u, v, a, t) and its meaning.
skills.tier_2_metric: Select the appropriate SUVAT equation to solve a given one-dimensional problem with constant acceleration.

skills.name: Apply SUVAT equations to solve 1D problems
skills.tier_1_metric: Substitute given numerical values into an appropriate SUVAT equation to find a single unknown.
skills.tier_2_metric: Solve multi-step problems involving constant acceleration, including scenarios with initial conditions and changes in motion.

skills.name: Analyze free-fall motion
skills.tier_1_metric: Define free fall; state the approximate value and direction of acceleration due to gravity (g).
skills.tier_2_metric: Apply SUVAT equations to problems involving objects falling or thrown vertically under gravity; explain the idealization of neglecting air resistance.

skills.name: Derive SUVAT equations from v-t graphs (HL)
skills.tier_1_metric: Explain the relationship between the area under a v-t graph and displacement, and the gradient of a v-t graph and acceleration.
skills.tier_2_metric: Derive one or more of the SUVAT equations using graphical methods (e.g., area under a v-t graph for displacement).

skills.name: Resolve vectors into perpendicular components
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify horizontal and vertical components of a velocity or displacement vector given its magnitude and angle.
skills.tier_2_metric: Calculate the magnitude and direction of a resultant vector from its components; apply trigonometry to resolve vectors into components.

skills.name: Understand the independence of horizontal and vertical motion
skills.tier_1_metric: State that horizontal and vertical motions are independent in projectile motion.
skills.tier_2_metric: Explain why horizontal velocity is constant and vertical motion is uniformly accelerated under gravity for a projectile.

skills.name: Analyze projectile motion problems
skills.tier_1_metric: Identify initial conditions (launch speed, angle) and target variables (range, maximum height, time of flight) for a projectile.
skills.tier_2_metric: Apply SUVAT equations separately to horizontal and vertical components to calculate range, maximum height, and time of flight for projectiles launched at an angle or horizontally.

skills.name: Interpret projectile trajectories
skills.tier_1_metric: Describe the parabolic path of a projectile in the absence of air resistance.
skills.tier_2_metric: Compare and contrast trajectories for different launch angles or initial speeds; predict how changes in initial conditions affect the trajectory.
